blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robust initialization is crucial for online systems. In the letter, a high-frequency and resilient initialization framework is designed for LiDAR-inertial systems, leveraging both inertial sensors and Doppler LiDAR. The innovative FMCW Doppler LiDAR opens up a novel avenue for robotic sensing by capturing not only point range but also Doppler velocity via the intrinsic Doppler effect. By fusing point-wise Doppler velocity with inertial measurements under non-inertial kinematics, the proposed framework, Free-Init , eliminates reliance on motion undistortion of LiDAR scans, excitation motions, and map correspondences during the initialization phase. Free-Init is also plug-and-play compatible with typical LiDAR-inertial systems and is versatile to handle a wide range of initial motions when the system starts, including stationary, dynamic, and even violent motions. The embedded Doppler-inertial velocimeter ensures fast convergence and high-frequency performance, delivering outputs exceeding 10 kHz. Comprehensive experiments on diverse platforms and across myriad motion scenes validate the framework’s effectiveness. The results demonstrate the superior performance of Free-Init, highlighting the necessity of fast, resilient, and dynamic initialization for online systems.
blocks.zh: 强有力的初始化对于在线系统至关重要。 在字母中,为LiDAR-惰性系统设计了一个高频和弹性初始化框架,同时利用惯性传感器和多普勒LiDAR. 创新的FMCW 多普勒LiDAR通过内在的多普勒效应不仅捕捉到点范围,还捕捉到多普勒速度,开启了机器人感知的新途径. 通过在非惯性动因学下将点向的多普勒速度与惯性度测量相配合,拟议的框架Free-Init 消除了在初始化阶段对LiDAR扫描的运动分解的依赖,激发运动,以及映射对应. Free-Init也是与典型的LiDAR-inertial系统兼容的插座和游戏,在系统启动时具有多种能力处理广泛的初始运动,包括静止,动态,甚至暴力运动. 嵌入式多普勒-惰性速率计能确保快速汇合和高频性能,输出量超过10千赫。 在各种平台和众多运动场景上的全面实验验证了框架的有效性。 结果显示Free-Init的优异性能,突出了快速,弹性,动态初始化对在线系统的必要性.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Light Detection And Ranging (LiDAR) sensors and Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) are commonly employed to facilitate real-time state estimation and environmental mapping. LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) systems are widely applied in various field scenarios, including extreme environments [ 1 , 2 ] . For mobile robots, online LIO not only provides state estimates for planners and controllers but also generates dense maps for perception and navigation.
blocks.zh: 光探测和测距传感器和惯性测量单元通常用于促进实时状态估计和环境绘图。 LiDAR-惰性偏振(LIO)系统广泛应用于各种场景,包括极端环境[1,2]. 对于移动机器人,在线LIO不仅为规划者和控制者提供状态估计,还生成用于感知和导航的密集地图.

blocks.en: I-A Initialization in LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
blocks.zh: LiDAR-惯性测量学的初始化

blocks.en: Owing to the intrinsic non-linearity, online LIO systems require accurate initial states (e.g., initial poses, velocities, IMU biases) or prior information (e.g., global poses) from the initialization module to ensure the accuracy, stability, and convergence of online estimators. However, there is a scarcity of research regarding the initialization in LIO systems. The initialization in mainstream LIO systems is straightforwardly based on the stationary motion assumption [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] , where the initial rotation can be set to identity or be derived by normalization methods, the initial position and velocity are readily set to zero. Then IMU biases and the gravity vector can be computed using static IMU measurements. Some methods require additional sensors for initialization or calibration. In [ 8 ] , the authors utilize a camera as an auxiliary sensor to calibrate the temporal-spatial offsets between LiDAR and IMU. Likewise, the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) sensor is leveraged in [ 9 ] to constrain the pose estimation. Besides, a minority of initialization methods rely on specific excitation motions to estimate temporal offsets, IMU biases, extrinsic parameters for subsequent LIO systems [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于内在的非线性,在线LIO系统需要精确的初始状态(如初始状态,速度,IMU偏差)或来自初始化模块的先前信息(如全球状态),以确保在线估计器的准确性,稳定性和趋同性. 然而,关于LIO系统初始化的研究很少。 主流LIO系统中的初始化直接基于静止运动假设[3, 4, 5, 6, 7],即初始旋转可以设定为身份或通过正常化方法得到,初始位置和速度很容易设定为零. 然后可以通过静态的IMU测量来计算IMU偏差和重力矢量. 有些方法需要额外的传感器来初始化或校准. 在[8]中,作者使用相机作为辅助传感器,校准LiDAR和IMU之间的时空抵消. 同样,全球导航卫星系统(GNSS)传感器在[9]中被利用来限制姿势估计。 此外,少数初始化方法依赖具体的激发动议来估计时间抵消、IMU偏差、以后的LIO系统外部参数[10]。

blocks.en: However, despite the methods in [ 10 , 8 , 9 ] can run online and serve as initialization modules before the LIO system starts, these methods necessitate additional sensors or specific excitation motions. Importantly, these methods essentially align with calibration methods rather than initialization methods. In addition, IMU biases, temporal-spatial offsets, and other states (e.g., poses and velocities) may vary upon each system startup. Moreover, it is challenging to perform excitation motions at each startup, particularly for specific configured platforms such as autonomous vehicles or large-scale drones. Essentially, following the design philosophy for rigorous and precise online systems, time synchronization and extrinsic calibration should be completed within the system design stage and prior to online deployment. Thus, the calibration of unknown parameters should not be handled within initialization modules but rather within calibration and identification processes. Notably, the true responsibility of initialization modules is to provide online estimators with reasonably accurate initial states and uncertainties, ensuring stability and convergence, irrespective of platform motions, operational modes, or environments, while preventing system divergences or failures.
blocks.zh: 然而,尽管[10,8,9]中的方法可以在线运行,在LIO系统开始前作为初始化模块,但这些方法需要额外的传感器或具体的激发动作. 重要的是,这些方法基本上与校准方法一致,而不是初始化方法。 此外,IMU偏差、时间空间抵消以及其它状态(如姿势和速度)可能因系统启动而异。 此外,在每次启动时执行激发动议,特别是针对诸如自主车辆或大型无人驾驶飞机等具体配置的平台,是一项挑战。 基本上,遵循严格准确的在线系统的设计理念,时间同步和外部校准应在系统设计阶段和在线部署之前完成。 因此,未知参数的校准不应在初始化模块中处理,而应在校准和识别过程中处理。 值得注意的是,初始化模块的真正责任是向在线估算员提供合理准确的初始状态和不确定性,确保稳定性和趋同性,而不论平台运动、操作模式或环境如何,同时防止系统差异或故障。

blocks.en: I-B Crux and Ideal Initialization
blocks.zh: I-B Crux 和理想初始化

blocks.en: When the system starts, significant errors often manifest in the initial states. In LIO systems, these large initial errors can lead to cumulative errors in LiDAR scans and maps, which supply observations for state estimation through undistorted scans and map correspondences. Simultaneously, erroneous observations can further exacerbate estimation errors. This dependence between the estimator, LiDAR scans, and the online-established map, creates a positive feedback loop of errors, which can potentially lead to system divergence [ 11 ] . Crucially, conventional LiDARs can only provide geometric observations which are directly associated with the known system poses and environmental structures, whereas initialization modules should inherently and independently provide accurate initial states to subsequent estimators, in the absence of known poses, velocities, and maps. Hence, employing conventional LiDAR data in initialization creates a similar chicken-and-egg paradox. Thereby, typical LIO systems [ 3 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] rely solely on IMU data under certain motion assumptions during initialization. Similarly, dynamic initialization that relies on loosely-coupled LiDAR odometry [ 10 ] fails to fundamentally address the above correspondence-dependency issue. Moreover, online initialization in degenerate scenes (e.g., tunnels, highways, flat terrains) can directly lead to system failures.
blocks.zh: 系统启动时,在初始状态中经常出现重大错误. 在LIO系统中,这些巨大的初始错误会导致LiDAR扫描和地图的累积错误,这些扫描和地图通过未分解的扫描和地图对应为状态估计提供观测. 与此同时,错误的观察可能进一步加剧估计错误。 估计器LiDAR扫描器和在线设定的地图之间的这种依赖性产生了一个正反馈错误循环,这有可能导致系统差异[11]. 关键的是,常规的LiDARs只能提供直接与已知系统外观和环境结构有关的几何观测,而初始化模块在缺乏已知的姿势、速度和地图的情况下,应内在和独立地为后续估计者提供准确的初始状态。 因此,在初始化过程中使用常规的LiDAR数据造成了类似的鸡蛋悖论. 因此,典型的LIO系统[3, 5, 6, 7]完全依赖IMU在初始化过程中在某些运动假设下的数据. 同样,依赖松散的LiDAR odometh [10] 的动态初始化不能从根本上解决上述函证依赖性问题. 此外,在退化场景(如隧道,高速公路,平坦地形)中的在线初始化可直接导致系统故障.

blocks.en: Overall, an ideal initialization module for online LIO should be independent of platform motions, accumulated LiDAR scans, LiDAR maps, and environmental structures. Significantly, it should also be capable of offering accurate initial states and maps to the subsequent online estimator, regardless of when , where , and how the system starts.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在线LIO的理想初始化模块应该独立于平台运动,累积的LiDAR扫描,LiDAR地图,以及环境结构. 不论系统何时、何地、如何启动,

blocks.en: Fortunately, rapid advancements in LiDAR sensors are unlocking new possibilities for robotic sensing. One notable development is the Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDAR, which utilizes laser wave modulation in the frequency domain to capture instant range sensing and Doppler velocity [ 12 ] . The Doppler measurements provide observations independent of poses and geometric structures [ 12 , 13 , 11 ] . As a result, adopting FMCW Doppler LiDARs sparks a novel route to designing the aforementioned ideal initialization framework and addresses the crux from the correspondence dependency inherent in conventional LIO systems.
blocks.zh: 幸运的是,LiDAR传感器的快速进步正在打开机器人感应的新的可能性. 一个值得注意的发展是频率调制连续波(FMCW)多普勒LiDAR,它利用频率域的激光波调制来捕捉即时射程感测和多普勒速度[12]. 多普勒测量提供了独立于姿势和几何结构的观测[12,13,11]. 因此,采用FMCW Doppler LiDARs为设计上述理想初始化框架触发了一条新路线,并解决了常规LIO系统固有的通信依赖性造成的症结.

blocks.en: I-C Proposed Methodology
blocks.zh: 拟议方法

blocks.en: In this work, we propose Free-Init, an initialization framework for LIO systems. The framework overview is shown in Fig. 2 . Free-Init takes LiDAR points and IMU data as inputs. The designed Doppler-inertial velocimeter estimates the LiDAR velocity, body velocity, and gyroscope bias under a point-wise scheme with extremely high-frequency outputs (over 10 kHz). An optimization problem is then established to estimate accelerometer bias and gravity. Finally, the estimated states, uncertainties, and static map are fed into the subsequent LIO as initial estimates. In [ 13 ] , the authors use the FMCW Doppler LiDAR to design a scan-based velocity estimator, achieving an open-loop, correspondence-free LIO within a continuous-time framework. However, this estimator is not suitable for full odometry and cannot achieve the same accuracy level as conventional LIO systems over long periods, as discussed in [ 13 ] . Contrarily, we design a discrete-time velocimeter under a point-wise updating manner without any interpolation models, enabling high-frequency performance for robust initialization. Meanwhile, Free-Init is a complete and resilient initialization framework, leveraging all FMCW Doppler LiDAR, gyroscope, and accelerometer data.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出Free-Init,一个LIO系统的初始化框架. 框架概述如图2所示. Free-Init以LiDAR点和IMU数据作为输入. 设计的多普勒-惰性速率计在极高频输出(超过10千赫)的点向方案下估计LiDAR的速度,车体速度和陀螺仪偏差. 然后确定一个优化问题,以估计加速计偏差和重力。 最后,将估计的状态、不确定性和静态图作为初步估计数输入随后的LIO。 在[13]中,作者使用FMCW Doppler LiDAR设计了基于扫描的速度估计器,在连续时间框架内实现了一个开放的,无通信的LIO. 然而,正如[13]中所讨论的那样,这种估算法并不适合全斜面测量,无法在长时间内达到与常规LIO系统相同的准确度。 与此相反,我们设计了一个离散时间速率计,采用点向更新方式,没有任何插值模型,使高频性能能够实现稳健的初始化。 同时,Free-Init是一个完整且具有弹性的初始化框架,利用所有FMCW Doppler LiDAR,陀螺仪,以及加速计数据.

blocks.en: In summary, the contributions are as follows: 1. A complete, LiDAR scan-free, excitation motion-free, and map correspondence-free initialization framework, Free-Init , is proposed for Doppler LiDAR-inertial systems. The framework design consistently aligns with the design philosophy of an ideal initialization module. 2. A novel high-frequency Doppler-inertial velocimeter is designed, exploiting the sensing nature of Doppler LiDARs with an efficient point-wise filtering scheme. 3. A formulation of Doppler observations, along with the estimation of accelerometer bias and gravity, is derived from a unified non-inertial kinematics perspective. 4. Extensively diverse experiments are conducted, demonstrating the effectiveness and robustness of Free-Init. 5. The source code of Free-Init, the data sequences, the integration of Free-Init into the F M C W - L I O framework, and the experiment video are made publicly available (see the Resources section for details).
blocks.zh: 总而言之,捐款如下: 1. 为Doppler LiDAR-inertial系统提议了一个完整的、无LiDAR扫描、无刺激运动和无地图通信初始化框架Free-Init。 框架设计与理想初始化模块的设计理念一致. 2. 设计了一个新的高频多普勒-惰性速率计,利用了多普勒LiDARs的感知性,采用高效的点向滤波法。 3. 多普勒观测的配方,加上加速计偏差和重力的估计,都是从一个统一的非惯性运动学角度推导出来的. 4. 进行了广泛多样的实验,证明自由投入的有效性和稳健性。 5. Free-Init的源代码,数据序列,Free-Init集成FM C W-L I O框架,实验视频被公开(详见资源部分).

blocks.en: III-A 2 Problem Description of Initialization
blocks.zh: III-A 2 初始化问题说明

blocks.en: Therefore, it is evident from ( 5 ) that the objective of initialization modules is to provide relatively accurate initial states and corresponding uncertainties to the subsequent LIO. These initial states include rotation, position, velocity, and gravity with respect to the world frame, as well as IMU biases in the body frame. Additionally, the noise covariance of IMU can also be estimated during the initialization step.
blocks.zh: 因此,从(5)可以明显看出,初始化模块的目标是为之后的LIO提供相对准确的初始状态和相应的不确定性. 这些初始状态包括旋转、位置、速度和世界框架的重力,以及机体结构的偏差。 此外,还可以在初始化阶段估计IMU的噪音共性。

blocks.en: However, most initialization methods in LIO usually depend on certain motion assumptions. One type is the stationary motion assumption [ 3 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 18 ] , while another is the specific excitation motion assumption [ 10 ] . This reliance stems from the fact that conventional LiDARs can only measure geometric point ranges for online estimators, which results in the immeasurability of velocity and IMU biases. Thus, the initial velocity can be set to zero under the stationary assumption [ 3 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 18 ] , or the velocity state can be estimated using LiDAR-only odometry (LO) during excitation motions [ 10 ] . Nevertheless, owing to the paradox discussed in Section I-B , conventional LiDAR measurements are difficult to be utilized in the initialization phase. In contrast, FMCW Doppler LiDARs can directly measure the Doppler velocity of per-return point, which is independent of environmental structures. Thereby, we propose an initialization framework for Doppler LIO systems that leverages inherent Doppler measurements and essential non-inertial kinematic connections, without relying on scan undistortion, motion assumptions, or map correspondences.
blocks.zh: 然而,LIO中的大多数初始化方法通常取决于某些运动假设. 一种是静止运动假设[3,5,6,7,18],另一种是具体的激发运动假设[10]. 这种依赖源于一个事实,即常规的LiDARs只能测量在线估计器的几何点范围,这导致了速度和IMU偏差的不可计量性. 因此,在静止假设[3, 5, 6, 7, 18] 下,初始速度可以设定为0,或者在激发运动中可以使用LiDAR-唯一odometry(LO)来估计速度状态[10]. 然而,由于第一节至B节所讨论的悖论,传统的LiDAR测量在初始化阶段很难使用. 相比之下,FMCW Doppler LiDARs可以直接测量每个返回点的Doppler速度,这个速度独立于环境结构. 因此,我们提出一个多普勒LIO系统的初始化框架,利用内在的多普勒测量和基本的非惯性动脉连接,而不依赖于扫描不完全,运动假设,或者地图对应.

blocks.en: III-B Doppler-Inertial Velocimeter
blocks.zh: III-B 多普勒-惯性极速计

blocks.en: The proposed Doppler-Inertial Velocimeter (DIV) estimates the LiDAR linear velocity, body velocity (both linear and angular), and gyroscope bias using point-wise Doppler velocity and gyroscope data (Fig. ( 2 )). DIV also outputs pose integration and a static map at an extremely high frequency, ensuring fast convergence and stability of the estimator. The integrated poses and estimated velocities are utilized in the following estimation of accelerometer bias and gravity.
blocks.zh: 拟议的多普勒-惯性极速计(DIV)利用点向多普勒速度和陀螺仪数据(图2(2))估算LiDAR线性速度,机体速度(线性和角性)和陀螺仪偏差. DIV输出还呈现集成和极频繁的静态图,确保了预测器的快速趋同和稳定性. 以下加速计偏差和重力估计采用了综合面和估计速度。

blocks.en: DIV utilizes point-wise Doppler velocity and gyroscope measurements to update states. Doppler measurements can serve as correspondence-free observations [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] , eliminating the need for data association from maps or scans during initialization. This approach effectively mitigates the cumulative effects of large initial errors. Moreover, point-wise state updating with individual LiDAR points enables extremely high-frequency outputs, which significantly facilitates the fast convergence of DIV.

blocks.en: It can be found that the proposed DIV can be formulated as a linear Kalman filter. Therefore, assuming the LiDAR point or the gyroscope measurement arrives at time step i + 1 i+1 , the updated state 𝐱 ¯ V i + 1 {\overline{\mathbf{x}}}_{V_{i+1}} and covariance 𝐏 ¯ V i + 1 {\overline{\mathbf{P}}}_{V_{i+1}} can be obtained from Kalman filtering [ 23 ] . For static initialization, zero velocity can be directly detected from ( 7 ) and ( 8 ). A strategy similar to the Zero-Velocity Update (ZUPT) [ 24 ] can be integrated into the framework, yielding a reduced three-dimensional filter specifically for the incremental estimation of gyroscope bias, akin to the mean-based static initialization method [ 6 , 7 ] . Notably, the DIV filter is fully observable due to the weakly observable gyroscope bias, stemming from the dynamics model in ( 6 ). However, as discussed in [ 13 ] , the gyroscope bias is unobservable in the velocity estimator only using the measurements from an FMCW Doppler LiDAR and a gyroscope. Hence, in practice, the gyroscope bias can also be removed from DIV during dynamic initialization and treated as a constant from the prior calibration or the latest update. In this work, the gyroscope bias is retained within DIV to unify the framework for both dynamic and static initialization.

blocks.en: IV-A Experiment Design and Data Collection

blocks.en: To assess the effectiveness of the proposed initialization method, we perform comprehensive experiments and analyze its performance based on both quantitative and qualitative results. Considering the short duration of initialization and different initialization methods can lead to varying levels of localization accuracy and mapping consistency in the subsequent LIO, we integrate Free-Init into two state-of-the-art LIO systems: FAST-LIO2 [ 6 ] (tightly-coupled) and DLIO [ 7 ] (loosely-coupled), while maintaining identical parameters and configurations as the default version, except for the initialization module. We evaluate localization accuracy (Section IV-B ), mapping consistency (Section IV-C ), initialization performance in structure-degenerated environments (Section IV-D ), as well as velocity estimation accuracy and time consumption (Section IV-E ) across diverse platforms, scenarios, and initial motion features.
blocks.zh: 为了评估拟议的初始化方法的有效性,我们进行了全面的实验,并根据定量和定性结果分析其性能. 考虑到初始化时间短,不同初始化方法可能导致在之后的LIO中本地化精度和映射一致性水平不一,我们把Free-Init整合为两个最先进的LIO系统:FAST-LIO2 [6](紧密对接)和DLIO [7](loose-coupled),同时保持与默认版本相同的参数和配置,但初始化模块除外. 我们评价本地化的准确性(第四节-B),绘图一致性(第四节-C),结构脱产环境中的初始化性能(第四节-D),以及不同平台、假设情景和初始运动特征之间的速度估计准确性和时间消耗(第四节-E)。

blocks.en: In [ 27 ] , the authors release a heterogeneous LiDAR dataset (HeLiPR) for place recognition tasks, including an FMCW Doppler LiDAR. However, the velocity of LiDAR points in HeLiPR is the absolute velocity after post processing, rather than the raw Doppler velocity. This limitation renders HeLiPR unsuitable for online state estimation. Thus, given the absence of public FMCW Doppler LiDAR-inertial datasets containing raw Doppler measurements, it is necessary to collect a dataset to validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. An FMCW Doppler LiDAR, Aeva Aeries II [ 28 ] , and an Xsens MTi-G-710 IMU are used to assemble our FMCW Doppler LiDAR-inertial sensor suite. The sensor suite can be mounted on handheld, wheeled, and vehicular platforms (Fig. 3 ). The frequency of IMU measurements is 200 Hz, and the camera on the sensor suite is only for First-Person-View (FPV) recording. The computing device is equipped with an Intel i7-1165G7 CPU. The sensor suite is held by a person on the handheld platform. The speed of the handheld platform is slow (about 1.5 m/s), while the wheeled platform moves faster (up to 6.5 m/s). The speed of the vehicular platform is significantly higher, ranging from 60 to 75 km/h. It is also ensured that the starting and ending positions of data sequences (except for dyna_05 and dyna_06 ) precisely coincide to facilitate the end-to-end evaluation of localization accuracy. The RTK GNSS provides ground-truth positions for the handheld and wheeled platforms. For the vehicular platform, the dual RTK GNSS integrated with inertial navigation systems (RTK/INS) offers 6-DoF pose and velocity truths (Fig. 3 (c)). To validate the effectiveness of Free-Init for dynamic initialization, the dyna sequences in Table I commence with vigorous dynamic rotational and translational motions, while the stat sequences remain stationary for approximately the initial 1 to 2 seconds. The distances and initial motion features of data sequences are presented in Table I . In Free-Init, the data accumulation time is a configurable parameter, and in the experiments, we maintain consistent parameters and settings across the compared methods. The demonstration video of experiments is available at: https://youtu.be/FbyzvJ-4bHI .
blocks.zh: 在[27]中,作者发布了用于位置识别任务的异样的LiDAR数据集(HeLiPR),包括一个FMCW Doppler LiDAR. 然而,HeLiPR中LiDAR点的速度是后处理后的绝对速度,而不是原始的多普勒速度. 这一限制使得HeLiPR不适合在线状态估计. 因此,鉴于没有包含原始多普勒测量值的公共FMCW Doppler LiDAR-inertial数据集,有必要收集一个数据集来验证拟议框架的有效性. 一个FMCW Doppler LiDAR, Aeva Aeries II [28],和一个Xsens MTi-G-710 IMU用来组装我们的FMCW Doppler LiDAR-惰性传感器套件. 感应套件可以挂在手持式,轮式,以及车辆平台(图3)上. IMU测量的频率为200赫兹,传感器套房上的相机仅用于First-Person-View(FPV)记录. 计算设备配备了Intel i7-1165G7 CPU. 感应套房由手持平台上的人持有. 手持式月台的速度较慢(约1.5 m/s),而轮式月台的移动速度较快(最高6.5 m/s). 车辆站台速度明显提高,速度从60公里到75公里/小时不等. 还确保了数据序列的起始和结束位置(dyna_05和dyna_06除外)精确吻合,以便于对本地化准确性进行端到端评价. RTK GNSS为手持和轮式平台提供地面真实位置。 就车辆平台而言,与惯性导航系统(RTK/INS)相结合的双重RTK全球导航卫星系统提供了6-DoF的姿势和速度真实性(图3(c))。 为了验证Free-Init对动态初始化的有效性,表一中的堤坝序列以强烈的动态旋转和翻译运动开始,而STAT序列则保持了大约1到2秒的静止状态. 数据序列的距离和初始运动特征见表一。 在Free-Init中,数据积累时间是一个可配置参数,在实验中,我们通过比较方法保持一致的参数和设置. 实验的示范录像见:https://youtu.be/FbyzvJ-4bHI。

blocks.en: IV-B Localization Accuracy
blocks.zh: IV-B 本地化精确度

blocks.en: We embed Free-Init into two LIO systems and evaluate its impact on localization accuracy. Notably, we maintain identical system parameters when evaluating different methods, only except for the initialization module. The results are shown in Table II . In dyna sequences, the system starts with severely dynamic rotational and translational motions. It can be found that in the dyna sequences, Free-Init significantly outperforms the default initialization method on localization accuracy. Particularly, in dyna_02 and dyna_04 sequences where the system starts with both fast translational and rotational motions, the default method leads to system failures of the subsequent LIO. Contrarily, the system equipped with Free-Init exhibits high accuracy in returning to starting positions, thanks to precise estimation of velocities and poses during initialization. The estimated trajectories of different methods with FAST-LIO2 [ 6 ] in dyna_01 are depicted in Fig. 4 , and the default method yields considerable errors (6.65 m) due to the dynamic motion during initialization. Notably, the fast vehicle speeds in dyna_05 and dyna_05 pose significant challenges for both initialization and subsequent LIO systems. However, systems with Free-Init can still achieve accurate localization. In stat sequences, Free-Init achieves comparable yet more accurate localization accuracy than the default initialization. This improvement arises from the inherent dynamic point removal and the ZUPT-like strategy during static initialization, enabling the establishment of a static map. This static map can further provide consistent constraints for the subsequent LIO and prevent potential drifts. In contrast, the default methods discard all LiDAR points during initialization, thereby failing to provide sufficient constraints in the initial running stage of the subsequent LIO. The results reveal that a resilient initialization module can offer accurate initial states for online systems and prevent failures in challenging dynamic cases, regardless of loosely-coupled or tightly-coupled frameworks.
blocks.zh: 我们将Free-Init嵌入两个LIO系统,并评价其对本地化准确性的影响. 值得注意的是,我们在评价不同方法时只保留相同的系统参数,但初始化模块除外. 结果见表二。 在堤坝序列中,系统从剧烈的动态旋转和翻译运动开始. 可以看出,在堤坝序列中,Free-Init在本地化精度上大大超过了默认初始化方法. 特别是,在dyna_02和dyna_04序列中,系统从快速翻译运动和旋转运动两个方面开始,默认方法导致后续LIO的系统故障. 与此相反,由于精确估计了速度和初始化期间的情况,配备Free-Init的系统在返回起始位置时表现出高度准确性。 Dyna_01中的FAST-LIO2[6]不同方法的估计轨迹在图4中描述,由于初始化过程中的动态运动,默认方法产生相当大的错误(6.65米). 值得注意的是,Dyna_05和Dyna_05的快速车辆速度对初始化和随后的LIO系统都构成重大挑战. 然而,带有Free-Init的系统仍然可以实现准确的本地化. 在STAT序列中,Free-Init实现比默认初始化更精确的本地化精度. 这种改进源于静态初始化过程中固有的动态点清除和类似ZUPT的策略,使得能够建立静态地图. 这种静态图可以进一步为之后的LIO提供持续的制约,并防止潜在的漂移. 相比之下,默认方法在初始化过程中抛弃了所有LiDAR点,从而未能在后续LIO的初始运行阶段提供足够的限制. 结果显示,一个弹性初始化模块可以为在线系统提供准确的初始状态,并防止在挑战动态案件中出现故障,而不论存在松散或紧密关联的框架。

blocks.en: IV-C Mapping Consistency
blocks.zh: 四-C 制图一致性

blocks.en: After the initialization and a few seconds of subsequent LIO running, we can evaluate the estimation accuracy and consistency of different initialization methods from the established LiDAR maps. The dynamic initial motions render system failures with the default initialization, outputting chaotic maps. Contrarily, systems with Free-Init can handle these violent initial motions, generating distinct and consistent maps. In the top row of Fig. 5 , the sensor suite is handheld by a person who runs vigorously, performing intense rotational motions in the front of the building. Simultaneously, the system initiates with fast shaking and intense rotations during the person’s running. It can be found that the system with the default initialization collapses and outputs an extremely chaotic map (Fig. 5 (b)). On the contrary, the system with Free-Init can precisely estimate initial states while outputs a consistent, neat, and accurate map of the environment (Fig. 5 (c)). Similarly, the middle row of Fig. 5 shows the mapping results during initialization in a corridor with rapid and substantial rotational motions. As expected, the system with the default initialization suffers from a system crash, deriving a messy and meaningless map (Fig. 5 (e)). While the system with Free-Init can construct a sharp map, portraying distinct structures of the corridor. The top view of the corridor map is shown in Fig. 5 (f). As shown in Fig. 1 and the bottom row of Fig. 5 , the sensor suite is mounted on both the wheeled platform with a forward speed of 6.5 m/s and the vehicular platform with a forward speed of 75 km/h. The system initiates when the platforms are moving forward on the road. Obviously, the high speeds lead to vague mapping outputs even system collapses with the default initialization. However, the LiDAR maps generated by systems with Free-Init are consistent and clear, enabling them to offer accurate LiDAR correspondences for subsequent LIO systems.
blocks.zh: 在初始化和之后几秒的LIO运行后,我们可以评价不同初始化方法与既定的LiDAR地图的估算准确性和一致性. 动态初始运动随着默认初始化,输出混乱的地图而使系统失效. 与此相反的是,与Free-Init相关的系统可以处理这些暴力的初始动作,生成清晰而一致的地图. 在图5的上行,感应套房由一个人手持,他运行有力,在楼前进行剧烈的旋转运动. 同时,该系统在人员运行期间以快速摇晃和剧烈旋转启动。 可以发现,默认初始化的系统崩溃,输出出极其混乱的地图(图5(b)). 相反,带有Free-Init的系统可以精确估计初始状态,同时输出一个连贯,整洁,准确的环境地图(图5(c))。 同样,图5的中行显示在走廊初始化期间的绘图结果,并有迅速和实质性的旋转运动。 如预期,默认初始化的系统会发生系统崩溃,产生混乱和无意义的地图(图5(e))。 具有自由内涵的系统可以绘制一个尖锐的地图,描绘走廊的不同结构。 走廊地图的顶部视图如图5(f)所示. 如图1和图5的下行所示,感应套件同时挂在轮式月台上,前行速度为6.5米/秒,前行速度为75公里/小时. 系统在平台在道路上前进时启动. 显然,高速导致模糊的映射输出甚至随着默认初始化而系统崩溃. 然而,由带有Free-Init的系统生成的LiDAR地图是一致和清晰的,使其能够为后续的LIO系统提供准确的LiDAR对应.

blocks.en: IV-D Initialization in Structure-Degenerated Environments
blocks.zh: IV-D 在结构生成环境中初始化

blocks.en: An insight from the correspondence-free observation [ 12 , 13 , 11 ] in the proposed framework is that the observations are independent of environmental structures, even in structure-degenerated scenes. As a result, Free-Init is expected to offer accurate initial states for online LIO in both structured and structure-degenerated environments, regardless of dynamic or stationary motions. On the contrary, typical LIO systems estimate system states solely based on geometric observations, which often leads to estimation failures in degenerate cases. In particular, in scenarios where the LIO system is moving within a degenerate environment, Free-Init should be capable of accurately estimating the initial velocity for subsequent LIO. As shown in Fig. 6 , we test different initialization methods in degenerate tunnels on all forward moving handheld, wheeled, and vehicular platforms. It can be found that Free-Init can provide accurate forward velocity estimates to subsequent LIO systems (about 1.43 m/s, 6.23 m/s, and 16.88 m/s on the handheld, wheeled, and vehicular platforms, respectively), even in these degenerate scenes. However, due to the inability of the default initialization to estimate accurate initial velocity states and the lack of geometric features, the system exhibits erroneous backward motions immediately upon startup, ultimately leading to system failures. The results reveal that the Doppler-aided and correspondence-free observations in the proposed method are remarkably effective, especially in degenerate scenarios. The test results in degenerate scenarios also indicate that the proposed framework overcomes the geometric-correspondence-dependency paradox inherent in the initialization of conventional LIO systems (discussed in Section I-B ), fundamentally resolving the issue from the standpoint of the correspondence-free first-order kinematics.
blocks.zh: 从拟议框架中的无通信观察[12、13、11]中得出的一个见解是,这些观测独立于环境结构,即使在结构脱产的场景中也是如此。 因此,Free-Init预计将为在线LIO在结构化和结构解构环境中提供准确的初始状态,无论动态或静态动议如何. 相反,典型的LIO系统估计系统只根据几何观测来表示,这往往导致退化情况下的估算失败. 特别是,在LIO系统正在退化环境中移动的情景中,Free-Init应当能够准确估计以后LIO的初始速度. 如图6所示,我们在所有向前移动的手持式、轮式和车辆平台上,在退化的隧道中测试不同的初始化方法。 可以看到,Free-Init可以向后来的LIO系统提供准确的前进速度估计(分别为1.43米/秒,6.23米/秒,以及16.88米/秒的手持式,轮式和车辆平台),即使在这些退化的场景中也是如此. 然而,由于默认初始化无法估计准确的初始速度状态以及缺乏几何特征,系统在启动时立即显示错误的后向运动,最终导致系统故障. 结果表明,拟议方法中的多普勒辅助观测和无通信观测非常有效,特别是在恶化的情况下。 变质情景中的测试结果还表明,拟议框架克服了常规LIO系统初始化中固有的几何-对应-依赖悖论(在I-B节中讨论),从根本上从无函式一阶运动论的角度解决了这个问题.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This letter presents Free-Init, a LiDAR scan-free, excitation motion-free, and map correspondence-free initialization framework for Doppler LIO systems. The design of Free-Init is enhanced by point-wise Doppler velocity, aligning consistently with the sensing nature of Doppler LiDARs. The primary focus of this work is an initialization framework that aims to achieve a near-ideal initialization design without relying on motion or observation assumptions. This is also the first work to comprehensively showcase the performance potential of Doppler LiDARs across varied platforms, including handheld, robotic, and vehicular platforms. Furthermore, a pivotal insight in this work is that the core solution for initialization lies in the first-order tangent space of system dynamics (e.g., the first-order kinematics of LIO). More importantly, beyond the initialization of Doppler LIO systems, this framework can also be applied to offline multi-session mapping, robot kidnapping cases, online re-initialization, and online startup or switching of state estimators in challenging scenarios. In addition, the Doppler-inertial velocimeter can provide high-frequency velocity estimates for online planners and controllers, facilitating agile and aggressive maneuvers. Overall, the Doppler-aided methodology highlights the potential of Doppler LiDARs for future research and real-world applications, unveiling the essential role of the intrinsically velocity-aware sensors in robotic sensing and estimation systems.

Free-Init的设计通过点心的多普勒速度得到了增强,与多普勒LiDARs的感知性质一致. 这项工作的主要焦点是一个初始化框架,其目的是在不依赖运动或观测假设的情况下实现近乎理想的初始化设计. 这也是第一部全面展示多普勒LiDARs在包括手持平台,机器人平台和车辆平台在内的各种平台上的性能潜力的作品. 此外,这项工作的一个关键见解是,初始化的核心解决办法在于系统动态的第一顺序切换空间(例如LIO的第一顺序动因学)。 更重要的是,除了多普勒LIO系统的初始化外,这个框架还可以应用于离线多会场绘图,机器人绑架案件,在线重新初始化,以及挑战性情景中状态估计器的在线启动或切换. 此外,Doppler-inertial速度计可以为在线规划人员和控制人员提供高频速度估计,便于敏捷和积极的操作。 总体而言,多普勒辅助方法凸显了多普勒LiDARs对未来研究和现实世界应用的潜力,揭示了内在速度感知传感器在机器人感知和估计系统中的重要作用.
